validation.description: Test connection management with various error conditions

error_cases.expected_behavior: Should return a DNS resolution error
error_cases.recovery_action: Should attempt to use fallback server

error_cases.expected_behavior: Should return a port range error
Should return a timeout error after specified timeout period
error_cases.recovery_action: Should retry connection up to retry_count times

error_cases.expected_behavior: Should return a connection refused error
error_cases.recovery_action: Should attempt to use alternative server

error_cases.expected_behavior: Should return a network unreachable error
error_cases.recovery_action: Should check network status and wait for connectivity

requirements: Should implement retry mechanism with exponential backoff
Should not crash on any error condition
Should clean up resources properly after errors
